purpose: Teach: 閉塞/南方/先駆け/先取り/英訳/下宿/検知/絶叫

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、物流の閉塞、つまり閉塞リスクを回避しろ
lines.en: Keep this company's logistics from seizing up — head off any risk of blockage.
lines.style: Low crisp opening command, no preamble, every word dropped like a stone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。南方諸島の市場を開拓します
lines.en: Understood. I'll open up the markets in the southern islands.
lines.style: Prompt professional reply, brisk and level, a faint eagerness kept in check.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界の先駆け、つまり先駆け企業として地位を保て
lines.en: Hold our position as the industry's pioneer — the company that leads the way.
lines.style: Weight settling on the word pioneer, slow deliberate pressure, expectation unmistakable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。競合の動向を先取り、つまり先取りで分析します
lines.en: Understood. I'll analyze our competitors' moves preemptively — staying a step ahead of them.
lines.style: Confident update rhythm, ticking off the plan, a slight quickening toward the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社内資料の英訳を進めろ
lines.en: Move ahead with the English translation of our internal documents.
lines.style: Flat efficient directive, mid-list energy, already reaching for the next item.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員寮、つまり下宿型シェアハウスを新設します
lines.en: Understood. We'll set up a new employee dormitory — a boarding-house-style share house.
lines.style: Steady and methodical, a small warm lift on the share-house idea.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、品質検知、つまり検知システムを導入しろ
lines.en: Bring in quality detection — get the detection system installed company-wide.
lines.style: Final directive firmness, tempo clipped, the repetition landing like a stamp.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広告の絶叫表現を抑え、品位を保ちます
lines.en: Understood. We'll rein in the screaming hype in our ads and keep our dignity.
lines.style: Composed closing assurance, a dry half-smile audible, finishing on quiet steadiness.
